# GitHub Copilot Instructions — MedFinderAdmin

## Stack
Angular 18 (standalone components), Angular Material, AngularFire, Firebase (Auth, Realtime Database, Storage, Functions). TypeScript strict mode is enabled.

## Architecture Rules
- All Firebase access belongs in `src/app/services/` — components must not call Firebase SDK directly
- One service per data domain, named `*-data-access.service.ts`
- Use `LoadingService` to toggle the loading spinner around any async operation in a component
- Create/edit forms must use a `MatDialog` component — follow the existing `edit-*-dialog/` pattern
- Route access control is handled by `AuthGuard` with a `requiredRole` data property — do not add inline auth checks in components

## Patterns to Follow
- New data types need: a model interface in `src/app/models/`, a data access service, a manage component, and an edit dialog component
- New routes must be added as children of `system-admin-dashboard` in `app.routes.ts` with `canActivate: [AuthGuard]`
- Privileged Firebase Auth operations (creating/updating/deleting users in Firebase Auth) must go through Cloud Functions in `functions/src/index.ts` — not the client SDK

## TypeScript
- Strict mode is on — always type function parameters and return values explicitly
- Use the model interfaces in `src/app/models/` for all Firebase data — no `any` types for data objects

## Do Not Touch
- `src/environments/firebase-config.ts` — gitignored, contains secrets; use `firebase-config.template.ts` as reference
- `.firebaserc` — placeholder project ID, regenerated by `firebase init`
